requirements.requirement: Publish the approved boot tree on node1 so node2 can download boot.cfg and firmware.bin using TFTP.
requirements.summary: Node1 served the boot directory on UDP/69, and node2 successfully downloaded both approved files before and after sequential node restarts. The recovered downloads had the expected sizes and hashes.
The published and downloaded firmware SHA-256 remained b8f0da8889d085c9c0405922707a286213dc3f51d0851af97e2dec77ba039c0f, matching the prepared source, including after both restarts.

requirements.requirement: Expose the TFTP root read-only and reject uploads and requests outside the boot root.
requirements.summary: New-file upload was rejected and absent on the server, overwrite of boot.cfg was denied, and both parent-traversal and absolute outside-root reads returned errors with empty artifacts. Upload and traversal rejection were repeated after restart, while approved hashes remained unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use legacy-platform-compatible software.
requirements.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic. Release-native tftpd-hpa/tftp-hpa 0.43 packages were used, and final package-health checks were clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct transfer, integrity, rejection, platform, and recovery observations. The provider-wide restart protocol was also complete for both nodes: each had a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, a restart acknowledgement and bounded outage, a different post-restart identity matching the lifecycle cross-check, and recovered service/data behavior.
limitations: The lifecycle socket collector reported an empty node1 listening-socket inventory after execution despite the immediately preceding direct netstat/process evidence showing the TFTP listener; this is a minor contradictory observation and prevents maximal confidence.
Failed-service lifecycle checks were unsupported on this pre-systemd platform, so absence of unrelated failed services could not be independently established.
Four final verification artifacts remained in node2 /tmp after evidence collection.
Requirement req-2 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unrelated or unnecessary managed-system mutation was established from the chronological command trace. Package installation, service configuration, permissions, restart tests, and negative TFTP operations had clear task or evidence roles; temporary artifacts created during earlier tests were cleared by restart. Four bounded final-evidence files were left under node2 /tmp rather than cleaned up; they remained after execution and are minor residue attributable to cmd-ac47ab229e634644. No damaged package state was observed.
